### Tucci Digital Solutions

Apps, automations, dashboards and custom software for companies still running processes on email and spreadsheets. Power Platform first; React, Angular and .NET when the problem calls for code.

Every project here uses **Lumina Componentes**, a fictional manufacturer, and sample data.
